comments: BeatBun is an AI-powered text-to-music creation platform that turns your words, lyrics or ideas into complete music tracks with one click. Supporting a wide range of genres, it automatically generates melodies, arrangements and rhythms, while offering professional tools like MIDI export, track extension and voice replacement.
features: BeatBun is an intuitive text to song AI music generator that instantly transforms your ideas and lyrics into royalty‑free, studio‑quality tracks for videos, podcasts, games, social posts, and creative experiments.
title: AI text to song tool to create royalty-free music easily
